newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin says CIS summit success, vows closer ties.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin says CIS summit success, vows closer ties.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin declared Friday's summit of the former Soviet republics in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) a success, saying the 12 leaders agreed to take real steps to economic integration.
"Our common opinion was that the movement toward each other will continue," Yeltsin told a concluding news conference.
"We accepted the concept of the economic integration of the CIS, for the first time," he added.

Sitting with his 11 colleagues on the podium in the Kremlin, the Russian leader acknowledged that, five years after the collapse of the Soviet Union, there had been frank criticisms by various leaders of the way the CIS was working.
But, Yeltsin said, there was a consensus to give the body more relevance and get down to action.
